summary: Pillen's office framed his October 2025 Israel trip as a 'trade and solidarity mission' while he was within a mile of Gaza hearing strikes, and he was scheduled to meet Netanyahu. In June 2026 he stated Palestinians 'want to kill every Jewish person.' A 2026 executive order requires Nebraska schools and universities to adopt the IHRA definition. Nebraskans for Palestine condemned the visit as normalizing a genocidal state.
